corpus.selection_method: Hand-curated across verticals where AI answer engines rarely cite the primary source: government and civic portals, universities and research institutes, NGOs, D2C and hospitality brands (image-heavy), healthcare providers, local-services marketplaces (JS-heavy), long-tail B2B and industry bodies, and modern SPA product sites. Domains are over-provisioned; the capture tool skips whatever is dead, blocked or robots-disallowed and reports coverage.
